camel_example: aliyun mse CreateApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Language JAVA --SwitchEnable true --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace prod --Source ACK --Tags '[{"Value":"tagKey","Key":"tagKey"}]' --AppName 'spring-cloud-a' --SentinelEnable true
kebab_example: aliyun mse create-application --biz-region cn-hangzhou --namespace prod --app-name spring-cloud-a --source ACK --biz-language JAVA --sentinel-enable true --switch-enable true --tags Value=tagKey Key=tagKey --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en: The region to which the application belongs
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The service where the application is deployed. The value ACK indicates Container Service for Kubernetes
parameters.help_zh: 应用的部署方式，ACK表示阿里云容器服务K8s
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The programming language of the application
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the Sentinel component
parameters.name: sentinel_enable

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to start the switch
parameters.name: switch_enable

element_fields.help_en: The custom tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 用户输入的自定义标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
